messages:
marie: Quick design check 1: proposing a compact floating mini-controls for streaming in the playground: Stop (primary), a tiny token counter, and prompt-lib quick-insert. Figma: https://redwood.design/mini-toolbar-snapshot

ash: Looks good. Desktop-first? placement relative to composer suggestions?

marie: Desktop v1, bottom-right above composer. If suggestions are open, we nudge left or float above so it never occludes. On narrow widths collapse to a single icon.

sam: Dev note: token meter updates per chunk are noisy. Debounce to ~250ms and update visuals via transform to avoid layout thrash. Stop should send a cancel. Regenerate goes under overflow to prevent accidental taps.

ben: UX: when hovering a prompt in the lib show "+N tokens" pill and expose the same on keyboard focus for accessibility and cost-awareness. Also: replace on regenerate + show toast "Response replaced 1 Undo".

kai: Accessibility: wrap streaming region in aria-live="polite" (aria-atomic=false) so screen readers don't read every chunk. Token meter needs aria-label (e.g., "token usage: 127 tokens") and non-color cues. Toolbar must be tabbable and Esc should stop stream + return focus to composer, honoring prefers-reduced-motion for animations.

a11y-bot: Run keyboard-only flows, NVDA/VoiceOver checks, and contrast tests for token meter.

marie: Microcopy drafts: Stop -> "Stop" tooltip "Stop 1 keep partial"; Regenerate -> "Regenerate" tooltip "Restart from prompt". Shorten if space is tight.

ash: Add small fade+lift on appear, reduced motion when preferred. Collision detection for suggestions is a must.

sam: I'll prototype debounce + Esc handling this afternoon and paste a short GIF.

ben: I'll write the quick-insert token delta copy and the undo toast string.

kai: Will run VoiceOver once comps are in Figma.

marie: Thanks 1 assigning follow-ups: ash update comps (collapse/compact modes), sam prototype, ben copy, kai a11y pass. Will reconvene in design sync. :sparkles:
